Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS/MECHANICS (observed): WASD moves; Space jumps (never observed to vault fences); E interacts/picks up only when a prompt ('[E] ...') is centered on the item; mouse/arrow keys turn camera; '1' is unbound ('Select weapon/item' tooltip); scroll did nothing obvious; J fired with no visible effect while holding melee weapon. Picking up a weapon swaps current item (pistol and later a pipe/melee weapon both held at times). Teammates (Coach, Ellis, Rochelle) show as glowing blue silhouettes, often visible through walls; they frequently block doorways. Health bars bottom-left; ammo top-right (seen as '15'); green box '+' icon top-right is a screen-anchored pickup notification, NOT a world waypoint. Small white '+' / arrow icons were also pickup notifications. Bright lamps wash out the view when close; walking into pipe-covered/lamp walls repeatedly jams the camera looking up, requiring S to back out before turning.

LOCATIONS/NAVIGATION: Started in a safe-room-like interior (dropped shotgun highlighted, first-aid kit); walked out to a rooftop (radio tower + smoke plume, white chairs, AC units, red curved hose/arc pipe, chain-link fences with barbed wire, 'The Vannah' sign, workbench/metal table, ROOF ACCESS door/sign). Roof-access structure contains a stairwell with blue handrails and a bright wall lamp; stairs have been seen descending BOTH left and right relative to the landing depending on facing, and there is also a pipe-covered dead-end wall there. A blue vertical beam marked an interactable near the roof-access door/workbench. Collected: first-aid kit and a melee weapon (pipe, orange-tipped) on/near the metal cart/table; found a purple item on a white table that was NOT pickable (no prompt). Fence perimeter of the rooftop loops endlessly and cannot be vaulted; red hose reel/arc pipe appears at multiple corners and is decorative.

FAILED STRATEGIES: Full perimeter fence loop (many laps) = dead end. Jumping over fences = fails. Trying to climb the large blue AC unit = fails. E on closed stairwell doors = no effect. Following the screen-edge green icon as a waypoint = wrong. Walking forward-diagonal into the lamp/pipe wall inside the stairwell repeatedly jams camera; must back up (S) and strafe rather than walk diagonally. The ROOF ACCESS door leads outside to the rooftop loop, not progress; interior back door of the room earlier also yielded nothing with E.

ACTIVE GOAL: Descend the roof-access stairwell to the lower floor. Current plan: back off any wall jam, strafe right (D) toward the blue handrail/dark stairs where Ellis/Rochelle stand, then move down WITHOUT walking straight into the lamp wall.

UNRESOLVED/UNCERTAIN: Whether the stairs truly lead onward or the level exit requires interacting with something not yet found; whether the purple table item and the blue vertical-beam object are objectives; whether a gate/gap exists along the barbed fence near the white tank structure or the yellow object at the building base (unexplored). Coach/Ellis/Rochelle are friendly (not infected); a 'dark figure' on the stairs was Coach. All three survivor health bars seen green. Melee weapon currently equipped; a pistol was held earlier.
